raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-KHM-BasicEducationImprovement",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Financial Management staff may be overloaded, causing delays in processing transactions and reporting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit additional FM officers and consultants within three months; implement streamlined procedures and regular workload monitoring.",
      "evidence": "Fiduciary section: FM staff may be overloaded, potentially leading to delays in processing transactions and reporting."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Late approval of the Annual Work Plan and Budget could postpone project activities.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a fast‑track approval workflow and set internal deadlines well before the World Bank’s cut‑off dates.",
      "evidence": "Fiduciary section: delayed approval of the AWPB may hinder timely implementation of project activities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Inadequate monitoring of school mentoring funds may lead to misuse or ineffective spending.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Introduce a dedicated mentoring‑fund tracking system, quarterly audits, and clear reporting templates for schools.",
      "evidence": "Fiduciary section: risk that school mentoring funding, spent at schools, may not be properly monitored."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "MoEYS procurement staff lack familiarity with World Bank procurement rules, risking delays and non‑compliance.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide intensive World Bank procurement training, assign a full‑time procurement officer, and use step‑by‑step checklists.",
      "evidence": "Procurement section: MoEYS staff’s limited knowledge of World Bank Procurement Regulations may cause delays and non‑compliance."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Potential corrupt practices in procurement could compromise project integrity and outcomes.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce transparent procurement disclosures, publicize award notices, and establish an independent complaint handling mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Procurement section: governance risks, including corrupt practices in procurement."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Limited capacity for contract supervision may cause implementation delays or quality issues.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create a contract‑management unit with trained supervisors and conduct regular performance reviews of contractors.",
      "evidence": "Procurement section: inadequate capacity for contract supervision and management may result in implementation delays."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Frequent floods, cyclones and extreme heat could damage schools and interrupt learning.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 5,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Construct climate‑resilient classrooms with elevated foundations, robust roofing, and emergency shelter features; develop school disaster response plans.",
      "evidence": "Strategic Context: 10% of schools in <2 m flood zones, 28% in severe flood zones, 31% exposed to cyclones, heat waves 23‑25 days annually."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Overcrowded classrooms (≥30 pupils) reduce teaching effectiveness and learning outcomes.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 5,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Accelerate construction of additional classrooms in high‑density schools and enforce maximum class‑size caps during implementation.",
      "evidence": "Component 2.3: 76% of primary students learn in classes with more than 30 students."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Insufficient teacher capacity and limited CPD may hinder improvement of student learning.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Scale up continuous professional development, mentorship, and career‑pathway programs; monitor teacher competency through regular assessments.",
      "evidence": "Sectoral Context: insufficient teacher capacity to effectively fulfill their roles; CPD planned to attract and retain specialists."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Limited access to quality early childhood education reduces school readiness for children aged 0‑5.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Expand public ECE classes, build 60 childcare centers, and run community awareness campaigns to increase enrollment.",
      "evidence": "Strategic Context: limited readiness among children due to inadequate access to quality childcare and ECE services."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "EdTech hardware may fail under extreme temperature or humidity, disrupting remote learning.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Procure climate‑rated ICT equipment, install climate‑controlled storage, and maintain a spare‑parts inventory for rapid replacement.",
      "evidence": "Climate section: ICT equipment designed to withstand extreme temperatures and humidity; housed in climate‑controlled environments."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Gender‑based violence could affect safety of students and staff, undermining participation.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Integrate GBV awareness training for teachers, strengthen school‑based grievance mechanisms, and monitor incidents through the GRM.",
      "evidence": "GBV paragraph: GBV remains a paramount concern; GBV programs integrated into project design."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "New school buildings may not fully meet universal design standards, limiting access for children with disabilities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Include disability‑accessibility checklists in construction contracts and conduct third‑party inspections before handover.",
      "evidence": "Disability inclusion: ensure newly constructed buildings adhere to universal design principles, ramps, accessible toilets."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Weak coordination among multiple development partners could cause duplication or gaps in service delivery.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Establish a joint coordination forum with clear roles, shared M&E data, and regular alignment meetings.",
      "evidence": "Project description: project will complement and build on activities already under implementation by other DPs; gaps in M&E noted."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "The Contingent Emergency Response Component manual may not be activated promptly during a crisis.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct annual simulation exercises, pre‑approve trigger criteria, and assign a dedicated CERC activation officer.",
      "evidence": "Component 4: CERC Manual will consider climate risks and facilitate release of IDA financing during emergencies."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Low adoption of the modernized HRMIS could limit data quality for staff management.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide hands‑on training, user support help‑desk, and performance‑based incentives for timely data entry.",
      "evidence": "Subcomponent 3.1: modernizing HRMIS to improve data recording; Phase 2 conditional on feasibility and alignment."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Insufficient staffing and resources for the Project Management Unit may impair overall project coordination.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Allocate dedicated budget line for PMU staffing, secure office space, and conduct quarterly capacity‑assessment reviews.",
      "evidence": "Implementation Arrangements: PMU will need additional resources for logistics, physical space, and transportation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Climate‑resilient construction may not meet design standards, leaving facilities vulnerable.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage certified climate‑resilient design consultants, perform independent third‑party inspections, and enforce compliance clauses in contracts.",
      "evidence": "Climate co‑benefits: designs incorporate elevated foundations, energy‑efficient systems, and climate‑resilient standards."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Failure to secure additional donor financing could limit scale‑up of interventions.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop a donor‑engagement strategy, prepare supplemental financing proposals early, and prioritize activities that can be delivered with existing funds.",
      "evidence": "Project Description: design allows potential accommodation of additional financing should those resources materialize."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Data quality problems in M&E systems may compromise indicator tracking and decision‑making.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement data‑validation routines, conduct periodic data‑quality audits, and provide refresher training for data‑collection staff.",
      "evidence": "Results Monitoring: data collected from government data, surveys, and progress reports; PMU oversees M&E tasks."
    }
  ]
}
